name: google-meet-clone
description: Open-source Google Meet clone - a full-featured video conferencing web app built with React, TypeScript, and VideoSDK. Real-time HD video, screen share, chat, recording, and host security controls.

paragraphs: A free, open-source Google Meet clone built with React, TypeScript, and VideoSDK. It recreates the Google Meet web experience - real-time HD video and audio, screen share, chat, reactions, raise hand, live captions, cloud recording, and host-authoritative security controls - with a pixel-accurate UI matched to Figma references.

If you are looking for an open source Google Meet alternative to learn from, self-host, or use as a starting point for your own video conferencing app, this repo is a complete, working reference implementation. Try it in the browser at the live demo, or run it locally in under a minute.

Most "build a Meet clone" tutorials stop at two people on a call. This one goes all the way to the parts that are actually hard: host-authoritative security with server-minted role tokens (not just disabled buttons), a real waiting room, late-joiner state sync over PubSub, cloud recording, and a green room whose live camera track is handed straight into the call so it never flickers.
features: Real WebRTC video conferencing over VideoSDK's SFU, not a toy peer-to-peer example.
Production-minded architecture - typed, linted, and covered by federated end-to-end tests, with the SDK hidden behind a single hook seam.
Pixel-accurate Meet UI built from a Figma file, using the real Material Symbols icons and self-hosted Product Sans.
Real-time HD video and audio over the VideoSDK SFU
Grid / gallery view with automatic, container-driven tile sizing
